text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error-rate on /v1/generate (canary). Severity: P2. Escalation: mike_oncall.

mike_oncall: seeing 5xx spike from canary nodes in eu-west-1. Alert shows 30% error rate for last 2 minutes.

sara_prod: confirming. Canary group 3 (quantized-v2) is showing latency + OOM traces in logs. Not seeing similar on main fleet.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started by @carla_reliability at 2026-03-16T09:41Z. 10% traffic -> 30% -> 100% in progress. Automated rollback policy: enabled.

mike_oncall: hold traffic, initiate kill-switch. Carla can you pause the rollout? @carla_reliability

carla_reliability: pausing now. Flipping feature flag canary_route -> off. Running drain sequence.

raj_support: FYI CS already getting one customer ticket about timeouts on chat sessions. Root cause unknown.

sara_prod: logs show OOMs on batch executor when sequence_len > 2048 on quantized-v2. Looks like kernel selection misfire for that artifact.

mike_oncall: automated rollback kicked in but traffic didn't fully revert from edge due to stale route caches. Need manual rollback + CDN flush.

carla_reliability: doing manual rollback to quantized-v1 stable sha: a1b2c3d. Steps: 1) pin model-version on routing rule to stable 2) flip feature flag to stable 3) drain canary instances 4) validate smoke.

mike_oncall: Execute. I'll coordinate CDN and traffic drain. Raj, can you start customer impact capture and update CS?

raj_support: on it. Notifying affected customer groups: trial accounts and streaming clients. Sending ack to CS with expected ETA 12 min.

carla_reliability: pin applied. feature flag set to stable. Initiating instance drain: `rb engine drain --group canary-3 --grace 30s`.

deploy-bot: Manual rollback command executed by carla_reliability. Jobs: drain started (3 nodes).

mike_oncall: CDN purge for route /v1/generate initiated: `curl -X POST https://cdn.internal/purge -d '{"path":"/v1/generate"}'` — status queued.

sara_prod: watching metrics. Error rate dropping from 32% -> 8% in 90s. Latency back to baseline.

raj_support: CS update posted: "We observed elevated errors during a canary rollout affecting a subset of customers. We rolled back the canary and are validating recovery. No data loss reported." :thumbsup:

carla_reliability: smoke checks: 5 sample calls with sequences > 2048 passed on stable v1. Run full canary health-check: `scripts/canary_health.sh --target stable --samples 100`.

mike_oncall: good. Keep monitoring for 30m. If error-rate > 5% or customer tickets increase, escalate to SEV1.

sara_prod: will watch. I'll open a follow-up issue to add a runtime guard preventing quantized-v2 kernel on long sequences.

raj_support: updated incident channel with ticket links and customer list. CS routing updated: priority-handling for affected accounts.

carla_reliability: postmortem note: rolling back full rollout, investigate kernel selection thresholds and add pre-rollout smoke for long-sequence paths.

mike_oncall: handoff to daytime oncall @sara_prod in 8 minutes. If anything changes before then call me. Closing paging for now but keeping thread open for verification.

incident-bot: Incident closed to P2. Postmortem assigned to carla_reliability, due in 48h.

mike_oncall: thanks team. Quick checklist for post-handoff: 1) verify edge cache flush completed 2) confirm drains finished 3) compile customer impact summary.

sara_prod: acknowledged, taking over monitoring and postmortem follow-ups.
